scientific_question: Across biological outcome subjects, does a source-side Decision Dependence model have lower doubly cross-fitted intervention-consequence prediction error than the matched Subject Identity model?

artifact_policy.result_publication: write to a new staging directory and rename only after validation passes
artifact_policy.historical_npz_object_array_policy: historical pandas subject arrays require pickle loading; permit it only after the exact archive bytes pass the committed SHA-256 manifest

consequence_reconstruction.outcome: per-subject mean cross-entropy increase after one frozen source-defined direction is erased
consequence_reconstruction.openbmi_direction_rule: exact deterministic reconstruction of the historical source-only SVD pool and persistence ranking
consequence_reconstruction.wbcic_direction_rule: load the historical pre-outcome frozen ERM persistence basis
consequence_reconstruction.head_rule: use the retained frozen task-head checkpoint; no retraining; recompute both intact and erased logits through that head in float64
consequence_reconstruction.openbmi_numerical_repair: the historical OpenBMI table mixed stored lower-precision intact logits with float64 erased logits; reproduce that legacy aggregate only as an integrity check, but use matched float64 intact/erased logits for every locked estimate
consequence_reconstruction.source_D_finite_repair: recompute both intact and erased source logits through the same frozen head in float64 and use that corrected D_finite in every locked MI-versus-MD fit
consequence_reconstruction.integrity_check: legacy-semantics trial-weighted consequence and source D_finite reconstructions must match the historical direction table within atol=5e-8 and rtol=5e-6; failure stops

prediction_models.standardization: training rows only; population standard deviation; features with SD below 1e-8 set to 1

OPENBMI_EQUAL_FAMILY_PRIMARY.training_cell_weights: equal method-family total weight; ERM, DANN, CORAL, and MMD each contribute 25%; weights rescaled to mean one before weighted standardization and ridge fitting
OPENBMI_EQUAL_FAMILY_PRIMARY.subject_error_aggregation: compute RMSE and MI-minus-MD within each method family, average the four deltas within backbone, then average the two backbone deltas within subject

OPENBMI_EQUAL_CONFIG_SECONDARY.subject_error_aggregation: pool the exact historical configuration grid within backbone, then average the two backbone deltas within subject

OPENBMI_ERM_ONLY_SENSITIVITY.subject_error_aggregation: pool three held-seed predictions within backbone, then average backbone deltas within subject

WBCIC_ERM_PRIMARY.subject_error_aggregation: pool three held-seed predictions within subject

cross_validation.why_cross_fold_pooling_is_forbidden: a subject held out as outcome in one historical fold re-enters source/model-fit roles in other historical folds
cross_validation.historical_fold_rule: use only the subject's unique historical outcome fold; the encoder and source directions for that fold excluded every outcome-fold subject
cross_validation.algorithmic_run_openbmi: seed within one backbone, with configurations and directions nested inside the held run; the other backbone never enters this fit
cross_validation.algorithmic_run_wbcic: seed, with all eight ERM directions nested inside the held run
cross_validation.training_rule: within the same historical outcome fold and same backbone, fit on the other outcome subjects and the other seeds only
cross_validation.training_target: equal-peer-subject mean C_sj within each retained training direction/configuration/run cell
cross_validation.test_rule: predict every cell in the held run for the held biological subject

primary_estimand.within_subject_backbone_rmse: RMSE over all doubly cross-fitted held-run predictions, frozen directions, seeds, and configurations for one subject and backbone
primary_estimand.openbmi_method_family_aggregation: for the primary, compute family-specific RMSE differences and average ERM/DANN/CORAL/MMD equally within subject and backbone
primary_estimand.openbmi_backbone_aggregation: compute Delta_s,b within each backbone without cross-backbone training, then average the two backbone deltas within subject
primary_estimand.dataset_point_estimate: unweighted mean Delta_s over biological subjects
primary_estimand.positive_direction: greater than zero favors Decision Dependence
primary_estimand.independence_rule: seeds, folds, configurations, directions, trials, runs, and backbone rows are repeated measurements and never independent inferential units

uncertainty.confidence_interval: percentile fold-stratified nonparametric biological-subject cluster bootstrap with the complete double-cross-fit ridge procedure refit in every draw
uncertainty.fold_stratification: resample the original number of biological subjects with replacement inside each historical outcome fold
uncertainty.openbmi_backbone_coupling: the same resampled subject multiplicity is carried through both backbones
uncertainty.duplicate_id_rule: all bootstrap copies of the held subject ID are excluded from its peer target
uncertainty.degenerate_draw_rule: if any positively weighted held ID leaves zero peer weight in its fold, reject the entire draw and continue until 10000 valid draws
uncertainty.sign_flip_test: NOT_PERFORMED; exchangeability is not established for overlapping peer fits
uncertainty.multiplicity: one primary MI-minus-MD comparison per dataset; dataset results reported separately; no pooled confirmatory p-value

decision_gates.dataset_supported_conditional: mean Delta_s > 0 and refitted subject-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
decision_gates.dataset_reversed: mean Delta_s <= 0 and refitted subject-bootstrap 95% CI upper bound < 0
decision_gates.dataset_point_ci_direction_conflict: POINT_CI_DIRECTION_CONFLICT if mean Delta_s > 0 with CI upper bound < 0, or mean Delta_s <= 0 with CI lower bound > 0; report the contradiction and do not map it to support, partial support, non-support, or reversal
decision_gates.openbmi_across_two_backbones_wording: allowed only if both backbone-specific primary point estimates are positive
decision_gates.cross_dataset_strong_support: both dataset primaries meet dataset_supported_conditional and the OpenBMI two-backbone wording gate passes
decision_gates.cross_dataset_partial_support: both point estimates are positive but at least one dataset does not meet dataset_supported_conditional or the OpenBMI two-backbone wording gate fails
decision_gates.cross_dataset_not_supported: either dataset point estimate is nonpositive
decision_gates.cross_dataset_point_ci_direction_conflic: if either dataset primary is POINT_CI_DIRECTION_CONFLICT, use CROSS_DATASET_POINT_CI_DIRECTION_CONFLICT before all other cross-dataset gates
decision_gates.cross_dataset_estimand_wording: OpenBMI equal-family full-grid and WBCIC ERM are two predeclared dataset-specific estimands, not an exactly matched intervention-bank replication; OpenBMI ERM-only is the mandatory direct-scope sensitivity

exp3_policy.reason: per-subject intervention outcomes and runtime embeddings/checkpoints were not retained
exp3_policy.required_reporting: retain the exact Exp3 run-level result but label its interval and sign-flip test algorithmic/run-level, not subject-population inference

binding_outcome_rule: Any weakening, reversal, or uncertainty must shrink the manuscript claim; prior run-level results cannot override this subject-level analysis.
stop_rule: Run this protocol once. Do not alter features, alpha, folds, directions, aggregation, seeds, gates, or datasets after outcome reconstruction. Implementation-only repairs require a documented discrepancy and a new audit commit; no alternative scientific analysis may be substituted.
